leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) headers to restrict resource loading
Configure HTTP security headers like X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options
Construct form validation with input sanitization to prevent XSS attacks
Apply secure cookie attributes (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite) in authentication flows
Integrate CSRF tokens into form submissions and API requests
Manipulate DOM elements safely using textContent instead of innerHTML
Initialize secure communication with HTTPS enforcement and HSTS headers
